proposed_from.topic: Adaptive root-N inference through a vanishing spatial-confounding cross-tail. For d in {1,2}, observe X(s_i) and Y(s_i)=beta X(s_i)+W(s_i) on deterministic quasi-uniform designs in a fixed bounded Lipschitz domain, with fill distance comparable to N^(-1/d), separation comparable to fill distance, and bounded local-stencil degree. Let (X,W) be a centered stationary bivariate Gaussian field with Matérn marginal smoothness one-half, compact positive scales and ranges, and cross-spectrum A(alpha_C^2+||omega||^2)^(-(p+d/2)), where p lies in a fixed compact subinterval of (1/2,1), A may have either sign or vanish, and the spectral determinant has a fixed positive margin. Construct three or more nested affine-annihilating local-stencil slope statistics and a finite-dimensional profile confidence set for beta over the observation-scale tail amplitude and p. Prove a uniform actual-design Gaussian experiment, feasible residual-scale studentization, asymptotic 1-alpha coverage through every sequence A_N->0, O(N^(-1/2)) worst-case expected diameter and squared-risk O(N^(-1)), plus a matching honest-length lower bound. Explicitly control boundary, aliasing, irregular-design, denominator and Matérn remainder terms; do not assume independent Fourier coordinates, known p, efficient constants, unknown marginal smoothness adaptation, or a broader covariance class. Use Burman-Ogburn-Datta's PM2.5/COVID county-centroid homogeneous slope as the conditional applied consumer when the Matérn and design diagnostics hold. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Three scales have the exact annihilator (tu,-t-u,1), orthogonal to both power-law nuisance directions v(t)=(1,t,t^2) and v(u), while its inner product with the slope direction is (t-1)(u-1); compact p-bounds therefore separate beta uniformly even when amplitude is zero. Reparameterizing the nuisance as the observation-scale amplitude B=A K(p)h^(2p-1) absorbs the apparent log(h) derivative. On the actual one-dimensional OU lattice this yields a conservative honest root-N profile interval, and an exact Gaussian KL calculation matches the rate. Exact-design affine stencil means and covariances plus numerical Bessel checks support the irregular d=2 route; affine annihilation removes its O(h) analytic bias and first-difference log-variance obstruction. Checks covered zero and sign-changing amplitudes, unidentifiable p, the two-scale failure, local and diverging amplitudes, exponent endpoints, boundary effects, unestimable ranges, and large variance constants; no complete current-literature collision was found. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove uniform Gaussian profile calibration and mathematical attainment of the least-favorable quantile on the actual quasi-uniform designs across all local-amplitude and exponent-boundary sequences. A terminating certified numerical approximation, with a proved error bound, is an explicit residual open question rather than a promised delivered object. EARLY KILL TEST: On adversarially perturbed d=2 quasi-uniform designs, certify a positive divided-difference separation constant for the exact affine-stencil moment curve, including coincident exponents, and verify the exact Bessel mean remainder is o(h); failure for every allowed fixed-radius construction forces a design/scope pivot. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest result is Datta and Stein's consistency characterization and local-differencing construction; the strict new object is a feasible, uniform finite-dimensional experiment for \(\beta\) with mean cone \(\{Bq_N(p)\}\), derived on the actual quasi-uniform design and valid when \(p\) disappears at \(A=0\). Guan et al. motivate local spectral separation but do not give fixed-domain uniform inference. Keshavarz et al., Loh et al., and Lim--Stein provide separate ingredients for local Gaussian quadratic forms, irregular variations, and filtered cross-spectra, but none proves exact affine cancellation, the divided-difference slope modulus, residual-scale studentization, and honest root-\(N\) profiling together. The matching lower bound is not advertised alone; it certifies that adaptation through the unidentified face costs no rate. Exact least-favorable quantile attainment remains the first-class open content.

seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Perturb \(\beta\) inside the legal \(A=0\) bivariate field and compare the exact finite-site Gaussian laws rather than expanding a scalar microergodic likelihood.

seed_details.rebuttal: The converse is deliberately paired with the nonregular attainable upper procedure; the paper-level content is free honest adaptation through an unidentified exponent, not the two-point inequality alone.

seed_details.seed: Prove a design-uniform joint root-\(N\) CLT and consistently estimable covariance for three exact affine-stencil slope moments, including boundary removal, Bessel remainders, denominator linearization, and summable off-diagonal covariance.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the fixed block preconditioner by observed-coordinate projections of three Laplacian templates and extend scalar quadratic-form trace bounds to the joint cross-forms generated by \((X,W)\).
seed_details.red_team: This is a routine multivariate extension of irregular-design quadratic variation.
seed_details.rebuttal: The exact affine projection is required to remove the dimension-critical \(O(h_N)\) analytic bias, and the cross-form covariance and secant separation are absent from the scalar results.

seed_details.destination_search: The search paired semiparametric efficiency, fixed-domain regression slopes, bivariate Mat\'ern nuisance ranges, and vanishing cross spectra. seed_details.seed: Derive the exact semiparametric efficiency bound for \(\beta\) and construct an attaining estimator uniformly through \(A=0\).
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Project the bivariate Gaussian score for \(\beta\) off the tangent cone generated by \((A,p)\) and the marginal covariance parameters.
seed_details.red_team: The bound is not a stable estimand when nonmicroergodic ranges alter finite-domain information.
seed_details.rebuttal: No verified route makes the efficient constant estimable uniformly over the stipulated range nuisance, so the objection currently holds.
seed_details.drop_reason: The accessible theory supports rate-optimality but not a uniformly attainable efficiency constant without strengthening the model or assuming estimable ranges.

seed_details.seed: Condition on the nuisance projection of the spatial moment process and construct a conditional quasi-likelihood-ratio interval for \(\beta\) that is exact in the limiting experiment at \(A=0\).
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Map the spatial moment curve into the sufficient-statistic decomposition of Andrews and Mikusheva before deriving a conditional critical value.
seed_details.red_team: Conditional inference is generic once a Gaussian moment process is available.

seed_details.destination_search: The search paired spatial confounding with policy learning and regret. The located robust-policy literature requires unit-level treatment choices and potential-outcome welfare, whereas the anchor and present model contain one continuous spatial exposure field and one homogeneous slope.
seed_details.seed: Use the adaptively inferred spatial slope to choose a pollution-reduction policy and derive regret to an oracle rule.

seed_details.red_team: A homogeneous association slope alone does not identify heterogeneous policy value or define a treatment-choice rule.

seed_details.drop_reason: Named search obstruction: the topic has no policy class, intervention map, or welfare functional, so M16 would be decorative rather than native.

seed_details.destination_search: The search paired data-driven spatial scale selection, Lepski methods, quadratic variation, and weak cross-tail inference. Scale selection can improve constants, but with only three fixed scales the exact nuisance curve already removes the logarithmic derivative.
seed_details.seed: Select the number and radii of affine stencils adaptively and prove an oracle inequality for profile-interval length.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Turn the fixed collection of variation orders into a multiscale selection rule while retaining simultaneous Gaussian approximation.
seed_details.red_team: This is tuning optimization after root-\(N\) feasibility, not a theorem-level identification or inference frontier.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for a first paper; scale optimization is a follow-on once uniform calibration is proved.
seed_details.drop_reason: The fixed three-scale experiment already gives the desired rate, leaving adaptive scale choice as a constants problem.
